question: 设 $f(x)$ 在 $\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]$ 上连续，求 $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{f(\sin x)}{f(\cos x) + f(\sin x)} \mathrm{d}x$ .
answer: $$ I = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {f (\sin x)}{f (\cos x) + f (\sin x)} d x + \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {f (\cos x)}{f (\cos x) + f (\sin x)} d x \right] = \frac {\pi}{4}. $$

steps.text: 分析 由于 $f(x)$ 是一个抽象函数的形式，因此没法直接计算积分，而 $\sin x$ 与 $\cos x$ 互为余函数，通过变量代换 $x = \frac{\pi}{2} - t$ 可以做到相互转换，但转换后被积函数的分母没变，从而积分就容易计算了.

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {f (\sin x)}{f (\cos x) + f (\sin x)} d x \stackrel {x = \frac {\pi}{2} - u} {=} - \int_ {\frac {\pi}{2}} ^ {0} \frac {f (\cos u)}{f (\cos u) + f (\sin u)} d x = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {f (\cos x)}{f (\cos x) + f (\sin x)} d x,
$$

$$
I = \frac {1}{2} \left[ \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {f (\sin x)}{f (\cos x) + f (\sin x)} d x + \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \frac {f (\cos x)}{f (\cos x) + f (\sin x)} d x \right] = \frac {\pi}{4}.
$$
